links.outcome: LLM performance on contamination-free, real-world open-ended clinical cases versus inflated static benchmarks
links.effect: Best model achieved only 39.2%; 84% of models showed performance degradation on post-cutoff cases, indicating data contamination inflating static benchmark estimates.
links.quote: Extensive evaluation of 38 LLMs reveals that even the best-performing model achieves only 39.2%, and 84% of models exhibit performance degradation on post-cutoff cases, confirming pervasive data contamination risks.

unlisted_practices: Continuously updated contamination-free benchmark with temporal separation from training data
Automated case-specific rubric-based evaluation of LLM responses versus LLM-as-a-Judge

screen.reason: The paper introduces LiveMedBench, a dynamic benchmark framework for evaluating LLMs on clinical reasoning, and benchmarks 38 LLMs without evaluating a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
